topic.name: PD-L1
topic.short_description: Immune checkpoint protein - predictor for immunotherapy response
topic.seo_title: PD-L1 Cancer Research - Latest Studies & Findings | Your Cancer Breakthroughs
topic.seo_description: Explore PD-L1 biomarker research for cancer immunotherapy. Discover how this immune checkpoint protein predicts treatment response and advances personalized cancer care.
topic.seo_intro:
PD-L1 is an immune checkpoint protein that has become one of the most important biomarkers in modern cancer research. This protein sits on the surface of cancer cells and acts like a "brake" on the immune system, helping tumors evade detection and attack by the body's natural defenses. By understanding PD-L1 levels, researchers and oncologists can better predict which patients may respond to immunotherapy treatments, a category of drugs designed to release these brakes and allow the immune system to fight cancer more effectively.

Over the past decade, PD-L1 testing has transformed from a research curiosity into a standard diagnostic tool in cancer care. Measuring PD-L1 expression in tumors helps oncologists determine which patients might benefit most from checkpoint inhibitor drugs and which individuals may need alternative or combination treatment strategies. This biomarker-driven approach represents a shift toward precision medicine, where treatment decisions are based on individual tumor characteristics rather than a one-size-fits-all approach. Current research continues to explore how PD-L1 levels relate to treatment outcomes across different cancer types, how to best measure this biomarker, and whether PD-L1 status can help predict response to newer immunotherapy combinations.

On this page, you'll find summaries of the latest peer-reviewed studies examining PD-L1 as a cancer biomarker and diagnostic tool. These articles represent cutting-edge research from institutions worldwide focused on improving how we identify patients most likely to benefit from immunotherapy and advancing the field of personalized cancer treatment.

articles.title: A First-line Multi-center, Single-arm Exploratory Study Using Low-dose Radiotherapy (LDRT) Combined With Durvalumab (MEDI4736), Etoposide, and Cisplatin/Carboplatin for Patients With Extensive-stage Small Cell Lung Cancer
articles.hook: Low-dose radiotherapy plus durvalumab improves extensive-stage small cell lung cancer outcomes
articles.summary: Researchers are testing low-dose radiation combined with immunotherapy and chemotherapy to treat advanced small cell lung cancer.

articles.title: A Phase Ib Trial of Vaginal Cuff Brachytherapy + Pembrolizumab (MK3475) Followed by 3 Cycles of Dose Dense Paclitaxel/q 21 Day Carboplatin + Pembrolizumab (MK3475) in High Intermediate Risk Endometrial Cancer
articles.hook: Pembrolizumab combined with brachytherapy and chemotherapy in endometrial cancer
articles.summary: Researchers are testing whether combining immunotherapy with radiation and chemotherapy improves outcomes for high-risk endometrial cancer patients.

articles.title: A Phase 3 Randomized, Open-label, Multicenter Study to Compare the Efficacy and Safety of Sacituzumab Tirumotecan (Sac-TMT, MK-2870) in Combination With Pembrolizumab Versus Pembrolizumab Alone as First-line Maintenance Treatment in Participants With Mismatch Repair Proficient Endometrial Cancer (TroFuse-033/GOG-3119/ENGOT-en29)
articles.hook: Sacituzumab tirumotecan plus pembrolizumab improves endometrial cancer survival
articles.summary: A study tests whether combining sacituzumab tirumotecan with pembrolizumab improves survival in advanced endometrial cancer compared to pembrolizumab alone.

articles.title: A Phase 3, Randomized, Open-label, Multicenter Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Sacituzumab Tirumotecan (MK-2870) in Combination With Pembrolizumab With or Without Bevacizumab Compared With Standard of Care as Firstline Maintenance Treatment for Participants With Persistent, Recurrent, or Newly Diagnosed Metastatic Cervical Cancer With PD-L1 CPS Greater Than or Equal to 1 (TroFuse-036/GOG-3123/ENGOT-cx22)
articles.hook: Sacituzumab tirumotecan plus pembrolizumab improves metastatic cervical cancer outcomes
articles.summary: Study tests combination drug therapy (sacituzumab tirumotecan plus pembrolizumab) versus standard treatment for metastatic cervical cancer.

articles.hook: GEN1042 antibody shows anti-tumor activity in solid tumors
articles.summary: A new antibody drug, GEN1042, is being tested alone and combined with pembrolizumab for treating solid tumors and melanoma, lung, and colorectal cancers.

articles.title: Phase I/II Study of the Anti-Programmed Death Ligand-1 Antibody Durvalumab (MEDI4736) in Combination With Olaparib and/or Cediranib for Advanced Solid Tumors and Advanced or Recurrent Ovarian, Triple Negative Breast, Lung, Prostate and Colorectal Cancers
articles.hook: Durvalumab plus olaparib and cediranib shows activity in advanced solid tumors
articles.summary: Study tests combination of three drugs targeting different cancer mechanisms in advanced ovarian, breast, lung, prostate, and colorectal cancers.

articles.title: The Selective Personalized Radio-Immunotherapy for Locally Advanced NSCLC Trial 2 (SPRINT 2)
articles.hook: Radiation combined with dual immunotherapy improves outcomes in PD-L1-positive lung cancer
articles.summary: Trial testing two immunotherapy drug combinations with radiation for advanced lung cancer patients with high PD-L1 levels.

articles.title: NeoCARD: A Response-Adapted Phase II Study of Anthracycline-Free Neoadjuvant Chemoimmunotherapy in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Patients With Cardiomyopathy or Elevated Risk of Cardiotoxicity
articles.hook: Carboplatin-paclitaxel-pembrolizumab spares cardiotoxicity in triple-negative breast cancer
articles.summary: A study tests carboplatin, paclitaxel, and pembrolizumab without anthracyclines for triple-negative breast cancer patients with heart problems.

articles.title: A Prospective, Open-Label, Randomized, Phase 3 Trial of Acasunlimab (GEN1046) in Combination With Pembrolizumab Versus Docetaxel in Subjects With PD-L1 Positive Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer After Treatment With a PD-1/PD-L1 Inhibitor and Platinum-Containing Chemotherapy (ABBIL1TY NSCLC-06)
articles.hook: Acasunlimab plus pembrolizumab improves outcomes in treatment-resistant lung cancer
articles.summary: Acasunlimab combined with pembrolizumab shows promise against advanced non-small cell lung cancer that resisted prior immunotherapy and chemotherapy.

articles.title: A Phase 1b/2 Trial Evaluating the Safety, Tolerability, and Preliminary Efficacy of Melphalan Percutaneous Hepatic Perfusion Therapy (HEPZATO KIT™) With Nivolumab and Relatlimab (Opdualag) in Patients With Metastatic Melanoma and Liver Metastasis
articles.hook: Melphalan hepatic perfusion plus nivolumab-relatlimab targets melanoma liver metastases
articles.summary: Researchers are testing whether combining a liver-targeted chemotherapy with immunotherapy drugs improves outcomes in melanoma patients with liver tumors.
